idea: Lagrangian count pricing: for a range of prices λ, maximise (sum of sides − λ·count) over guillotine/grid-tree layouts with a DP that never fixes the count. Each λ yields a layout on the upper convex hull of (count, sum). Then repair the count to exactly n with the cheapest local split, merge or delete, which finds good counts without enumerating every count.
